consignes.move: slithers forward like a snake, her long snake body making big exaggerated S-shaped waves that travel from her waist to the tip of her tail, the coils clearly rising and sliding on the ground, her upper body upright and swaying a little, the six arms holding the swords ready
consignes.attack: leans forward on her snake tail and slashes at the enemy in front of her with her curved swords, her six arms striking one after another, then rises back to her stance
consignes.death: is mortally wounded: her six arms go limp and drop the scimitars, her serpent tail coils beneath her and she sinks in a spiral, ending with her head resting on her coils, lying motionless on the ground at the end; no blood

mouvements.hit: flinches hard and is knocked back to the left, a big clear movement: the head whips back, the torso bends and twists backward at the waist, the arms flail in different directions and the long snake tail coils and ripples separately, a supple, loose, exaggerated movement, then recovers back to exactly its starting pose; stays on the same spot, nothing else in the picture

djinn.notes: Tour, niveau 5 : le soutien volant (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-11). Trois styles : la fumée d'or (L1 à L3), le féroce (L4 à L6), le djinn du ciel (idée de Claude, L7 à L9). Choix (2026-11-11) : L2-1 (fumée d'or) à 72 px ; idle-2, move-2 (penché en avant, la queue étirée), attack-2-r (fond en avant, coup de poing).
djinn.description: a djinn floating in the air: a purple-blue skinned muscular man from the waist up, a big green turban with a golden ornament, a long red beard, golden bracelets and armbands, pointed ears; from the waist down his body turns into a swirling tail of golden yellow smoke, no legs
djinn.sujet: a floating purple-blue djinn with a green turban, a red beard, gold bracelets and a golden smoke tail instead of legs, facing right
references: art-candidats/references/djinn1.png::concept and colour reference (a purple djinn with a green turban, a red beard and a golden smoke tail): keep these colours and this design, ignore the frame, the city and the ink engraving style

consignes.idle: floats in place, bobbing slowly up and down, arms crossed, his golden smoke tail swirling and curling gently
consignes.move: glides forward through the air, leaning forward, his golden smoke tail streaming and waving behind him
consignes.attack: swoops forward and strikes the enemy in front of him with both big fists, then floats back to his place
consignes.death: vanishes: his body shrinks and swirls into thin purple smoke that rises and fades away, his green turban drops to the ground, ending with only the turban lying on the ground, motionless

mouvements.death: is mortally wounded: its body sinks down and shrinks into a small heap on the ground; no effects, no other character

mage.notes: Tour, niveau 6 : le grand tireur (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-11 : pas de chapeau, grandes manches, vêtements amples, pas de bâton). Deux styles : brun (L1 à L3), vieux à barbe grise (L4 à L6). Choix (2026-11-11) : L3-1 (brun) à 76 px ; idle-2, move-5 (14 images/s), attack-5-r (les deux mains au ciel puis en avant) ; tir : un éclair bleu (« eclair »).
mage.description: a battle mage standing: a man with long black hair swept back and a short black beard, no hat, a very loose dark purple robe with huge wide sleeves, a long blue inner robe with a red sash and a golden collar, one bare hand raised forward ready to cast a spell, no staff, no weapon
mage.sujet: a bareheaded black-haired mage in a loose purple robe with huge sleeves over a blue inner robe, one hand raised, no staff, facing right
references: art-candidats/references/mage1.png::costume reference (a mage in a loose purple robe with very wide sleeves over a blue and red inner robe, casting from his bare hand): keep the loose robe, the wide sleeves, the colours and the bare head; ignore the lightning effect, draw no magic effect

consignes.idle: stands calmly, breathing slowly, his raised hand slowly turning and his fingers moving as if weaving a spell, the wide sleeves and the loose robe swaying gently
consignes.move: walking forward with steady steps, his feet stepping out from under the long robe one after the other, both arms swinging naturally back and forth with each step, the huge sleeves swaying
consignes.attack: raises both hands high above his head, palms open toward the sky, gathering power, then swings both hands forward toward the enemy to cast a spell, then lowers his arms back to his stance
consignes.death: is mortally wounded: staggers, falls onto his side, and his head drops down to rest on the ground on top of his long sleeve, lying motionless on the ground at the end

references: art-candidats/references/geant-l9-2.png::design reference (our own earlier giant): keep his blue skin, black beard, golden circlet, white and gold greek tunic, stone bracers and greek column; but give him a lean natural body, NOT muscular, not bulky
geant.notes: Tour, niveau 7 : le gardien (le Titan, plus tard, lancera la foudre). Trois styles proposés par Claude (2026-11-11) : gardien de bronze (L1 à L3), géant des montagnes (L4 à L6), géant arcane (L7 à L9). L9 choisi pour le style (peau bleue, barbe, tunique grecque, colonne), mais trop musclé, stéréotypé : refait mince et digne (L10 à L13). Choix (2026-11-11) : L11-4 (mince, à la colonne) à 105 px ; attente move-1 (il ne bouge pas les pieds), transform-1 (la colonne sur l'épaule), marche move-5 (depuis l'épaule), attaque attack-5-r (frappe le sol).
geant.description: a huge arcane giant standing calmly: a tall dignified giant with natural proportions, a lean slender build, narrow waist, long arms and legs, NOT muscular, not a bodybuilder, like a noble greek statue or an old philosopher; blue skin, a full black beard and long black hair, a golden circlet on his brow, a long sleeveless white and gold greek tunic with a wide belt, carved stone bracers on his forearms, sandals, holding a carved greek stone column as a weapon
geant.sujet: a tall lean dignified blue-skinned giant with a black beard, a golden circlet, a white and gold greek tunic, holding a greek stone column, natural proportions, not muscular, facing right

consignes.idle: stands calmly and breathes slowly, his free hand slowly strokes his black beard, the stone column held still
consignes.move: walks forward with slow, long, dignified steps, the stone column resting across his shoulder, held with one hand, the long tunic swinging
consignes.attack: grabs the stone column with both hands, raises it high above his head, then slams it straight down onto the ground in front of him, then lifts it back to his stance
consignes.transform: grabs the stone column with both hands, lifts it and lays it across his right shoulder, then holds it there with one hand, standing upright
consignes.death: is mortally wounded: leans on his stone column, the column tips over, and both topple to the left together, he ends on his back with the column on his chest, lying motionless on the ground at the end

homme-lezard.notes: Donjon, niveau 1 : la masse bon marché (référence de l'utilisateur, encre noire : couleurs proposées par Claude, 2026-11-11). Deux styles : lézard des marais (L1 à L3), lézard des cavernes (L4 à L6). Choix (2026-11-11) : L6-1 (lézard des cavernes, lance) à 46 px ; idle-3, move-5-r (la tête fixée sur toutes les images : le corps glissait), attack-2-r (éclat blanc de la pointe effacé).
references: art-candidats/references/donjon/homme-lezard.png::concept reference (a lean lizardman warrior with a spiky crest, a leather harness and a long tail): keep this design and this crouched fighting stance; ignore the black and white ink style
homme-lezard.description: a lean cave lizardman warrior standing in a crouched fighting stance: dark grey-blue scales, a pale grey belly, a crest of bone-white spikes on the head, small pale eyes, a long tail, a leather harness across the chest, holding a spear with a bone tip
homme-lezard.sujet: a lean grey-blue cave lizardman with a pale belly, a crest of bone spikes, a leather harness and a bone-tipped spear, facing right

consignes.idle: stays crouched and alert, breathing, his long tail slowly swaying from side to side, his head turning a little, the spear held ready
consignes.move: walks forward quickly, low and crouched like a lizard, his long tail swinging from side to side, the spear held ready, a smooth looping walk cycle that ends exactly in the starting pose
consignes.attack: draws back the spear, then lunges and thrusts it straight forward, then pulls it back to his stance

homme-grenouille.notes: Donjon, niveau 2 : le frondeur (référence de l'utilisateur, encre noire : couleurs proposées par Claude, 2026-11-11). Deux styles : crapaud des marais (L1 à L3), grenouille des cavernes (L4 à L6) ; puis plus méchants, en colère (L7 à L10, remarque de l'utilisateur). Choix (2026-11-11) : L4-3 (grenouille des cavernes) à 48 px ; idle-5 (le sac vocal orange se gonfle), move-1, attack-5 (la fronde reste dans la main) ; tir : la pierre de fronde (« pierre »).
references: art-candidats/references/donjon/homme-grenouille.png::concept reference (a squat frogman warrior with huge round eyes, a wide open mouth, a chainmail shirt, a round shield and a sling): keep this design; ignore the black and white ink style, the cave and the water
homme-grenouille.description: a squat frogman warrior standing on bent legs: smooth dark green skin with bright orange spots like a poison frog, an orange belly, huge round bulging black eyes, a wide mouth, a dark chainmail shirt, a small round wooden shield on one arm and a leather sling in the other hand
homme-grenouille.sujet: a squat dark green frogman with orange spots and belly, bulging black eyes, a dark chainmail shirt, a round shield and a sling, facing right

consignes.idle: stands on bent legs; the orange vocal sac under his throat slowly inflates into a big round orange bubble, then deflates back, like a croaking frog; he blinks
consignes.move: moves forward with short squat waddling hops on his bent frog legs, staying in place, shield and sling held
consignes.attack: holding the two cords of the leather sling firmly in one hand the whole time, he whirls the sling so its leather pouch circles above his head, then snaps his arm forward toward the enemy; the sling always stays in his hand; then returns to his stance

minotaure.notes: Donjon, niveau 3 : le brave, le mineur des profondeurs (référence de l'utilisateur, encre noire : couleurs proposées par Claude, 2026-11-11). Deux styles : mineur brun (L1 à L3), mineur noir (L4 à L6). Choix (2026-11-11) : L5-4 (mineur noir) à 84 px (un peu plus grand qu'un humain) ; idle-2, move-1 (12 images/s), attack-2-r (marteau levé puis abattu ; traînée, explosion et cailloux effacés).
references: art-candidats/references/donjon/minotaure.png::concept reference (a minotaur miner with long horns, a nose ring, a leather apron, a lantern at the belt, a big sledgehammer and a tufted tail): keep this design; ignore the black and white sketch style
minotaure.description: a burly minotaur miner standing: a bull head with long dark curved horns and an iron nose ring, black fur with grey streaks, a bare muscular chest, a rusty red leather apron over a fur loincloth, an iron mining lantern hanging from his belt, holding a heavy sledgehammer with a wooden haft, a tufted bull tail, hooves
minotaure.sujet: a burly black minotaur miner with dark horns, an iron nose ring, a rusty red apron, an iron lantern at the belt and a sledgehammer, facing right

consignes.idle: stands breathing heavily, snorting through his nose ring, his head tossing a little, his tufted tail flicking, the sledgehammer held
consignes.move: walks forward with heavy steps on his hooves, staying in place, the sledgehammer held, his tail swaying
consignes.attack: lifts the heavy sledgehammer high over his horns with both hands, then brings it down in a big arc onto the enemy in front of him, then raises it back to his stance
consignes.death: is mortally wounded: wobbles, takes two steps backward to the left, trips and falls on its back with its hooves in the air, lying motionless on the ground at the end

aberration.notes: Donjon, niveau 4 : l'horreur (référence de l'utilisateur, encre noire : couleurs proposées par Claude, 2026-11-11). Deux styles : chair pâle (L1 à L3), maladive (L4 à L6).
references: art-candidats/references/donjon/aberration.png::concept reference (a crouched monster with six long clawed arms, a toothy mouth in the palm of each hand and a huge fanged mouth across its belly, no head): keep this design and this crouched pose; ignore the black and white ink style and the signature
aberration.description: a horrible aberration crouching on two thick clawed legs: a headless body of pale pinkish-grey flesh with purple veins, six long muscular arms spread around it, each hand opening into a toothy red mouth with claws, a huge wide mouth full of sharp fangs across its belly
aberration.sujet: a headless pale pinkish-grey aberration with six clawed arms with mouths in the hands and a huge fanged mouth on its belly, crouching, facing right

consignes.idle: stays crouched in place, all the toothy mouths in its six hands and its big belly mouth open and close in turn, as if they were talking to each other, its arms turning a little toward one another
consignes.move: walks forward, staying in place: it lifts its left clawed leg high and steps, then its right clawed leg high and steps, its body bobbing up and down with each heavy step, its six arms swaying
consignes.attack: lunges forward and swipes all six long clawed arms at the enemy in front of it, the toothy mouths in its hands biting, its belly mouth gaping wide, then crouches back to its stance

ver-des-profondeurs.notes: Donjon, niveau 5 : le fouisseur, sur une case (références de l'utilisateur, encre noire : couleurs proposées par Claude, 2026-11-11). Deux styles : terre brun-gris (L1 à L3), larve pâle (L4 à L6).
references: art-candidats/references/donjon/ver-des-profondeurs-1.png::concept reference (a huge segmented worm rising out of the ground, spikes on its back, its head bent forward with a toothy jaw): keep this design and this rising pose; ignore the pencil style

art-candidats/references/donjon/ver-des-profondeurs-2.png::concept reference for the mouth only (a wide round mouth ringed with long teeth): ignore its pose and the black and white ink style and the signature
ver-des-profondeurs.description: a huge deep worm rising out of a mound of broken earth and rocks: a thick segmented body of pale yellowish-white grub flesh with darker ochre folds between the rings, a row of dark bony spikes along its back, its head bent forward with a wide round mouth ringed with long sharp teeth, drooling
ver-des-profondeurs.sujet: a huge pale yellowish-white segmented deep worm rising out of a mound of earth, its round toothy mouth open, facing right

consignes.idle: stays in place in its mound of earth, its body swaying slowly from side to side like a snake, its round toothy mouth slowly opening and closing, drool dripping
consignes.move: the worm swims forward through the earth like a sea serpent, staying in place: the spiky arches of its back rise out of the soil and plunge back in one after another, pushing up dirt and stones, the earth churning around it
consignes.attack: rears its body up very high, then stretches its long body far forward to the right in a big arc and plunges its head down onto the ground far in front of it, a full body length away from its mound, its round toothy mouth wide open facing the ground, closes its mouth there, then pulls its long body back into its stance
consignes.transform: dives head first down into its mound of earth and disappears underground, only the churned earth remains

tyran-oeil.notes: Donjon, niveau 6 : le tireur d'élite, il vole (référence de l'utilisateur, encre noire : couleurs proposées par Claude, 2026-11-14). Deux styles : peau marbrée violet-brun (L1 à L3), gris-vert maladif (L4 à L6). Ses rayons sont dessinés par le jeu.
references: art-candidats/references/donjon/tyran-oeil.png::concept reference (a floating round monster with one huge central eye, a wide mouth full of sharp teeth below it, and many thin eye stalks on top): keep this design; ignore the black and white ink style
tyran-oeil.description: an eye tyrant floating in the air: a big round body of sickly greenish-grey leathery hide with dark spots with bumpy scaly skin, one huge central eye with a yellow iris and a heavy brow, a very wide mouth full of long sharp fangs under the eye, about ten thin writhing eye stalks on top of its body each ending in a small glaring eye, no arms, no legs
tyran-oeil.sujet: a floating round greenish-grey eye tyrant with one huge central eye, a wide fanged mouth and eye stalks on top, facing right

consignes.idle: floats in place, bobbing slowly up and down in the air, its thin eye stalks writhing gently like snakes, its huge central eye blinking once, its fanged mouth opening and closing a little
consignes.move: flying forward to the right, gliding smoothly through the air
consignes.attack: swoops forward and strikes the enemy in front of it, then returns to its starting place

mouvements.death: is mortally wounded: stops floating, drops to the ground and rolls onto its side, eye closed, lying motionless on the ground at the end; no effects, no blood, no other character
mouvements.hit: is hit in the eye and pushed backward: the whole round body is shoved back away from where it looks, toward the left, and tilts back, the big eye squeezes shut, all its eye stalks whip and flail wildly, the mouth gapes, a very lively movement, then recovers back to exactly its starting pose; stays on the same spot, nothing else in the picture

hydre.notes: Donjon, niveau 7 : le géant, sur une case (référence de l'utilisateur, encre : couleurs proposées par Claude, 2026-11-14). Deux styles : écailles vert sombre (L1 à L3), noir et violet (L4 à L6). Choisie : L3-4, écailles vert sombre.
references: art-candidats/references/donjon/hydre.png::concept reference (a hydra on four clawed legs with a long coiling tail and several long necks ending in dragon heads): keep this design and this pose; ignore the black and white ink style, the ruins, the rocks and the copyright text
hydre.description: a huge hydra standing on four thick clawed legs: a heavy reptile body covered in dark green scales with a pale yellowish belly, a long coiling tail, and five long snake-like necks rising from its shoulders, each ending in a fierce dragon head with sharp fangs, small horns and red eyes, the heads turned in different directions, some mouths open and hissing
hydre.sujet: a huge dark green hydra on four clawed legs with five long necks ending in fanged dragon heads, facing right

mouvements.hit: cringes from a blow: all the heads duck and pull back toward the tail at once, then each head shakes and sways in its own way, mouths open, the body crouches back, a very lively movement, then recovers back to exactly its starting pose; stays on the same spot, nothing else in the picture

succube.notes: Enfer, niveau 4 : la tireuse qui séduit (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-15). Deux styles : robe rouge (L1 à L3), robe noire (L4 à L6). Son tir, un baiser de feu, sera dessiné par le jeu. L3-1 et L1-1 aimées mais peu lisibles : L7 à L9 plus lisibles (ailes noires, robe rouge vif, 84 px).
references: art-candidats/en-cours/candidats/succube/fixe/l3/1.png::earlier candidate liked by the user: keep this character, her face, hair, horns, gown and pose; make the shapes bolder and clearer, the wings black
art-candidats/en-cours/candidats/succube/fixe/l1/1.png::earlier candidate liked by the user: keep this character and her red gown
succube.description: a demon succubus standing in three-quarter view facing right: pale white skin, long black hair, two curved black horns, large black bat wings spread behind her with a clear gap between the wings and her body, a thin black demon tail, a long bright red gown with a high slit, her right arm stretched forward to the right with an open hand, glowing red eyes; bold simple shapes, strong contrast between the black wings, the bright red gown and the pale skin, a clear readable silhouette, few small details
succube.sujet: a pale demon succubus with black horns, black bat wings and a bright red gown, one arm stretched forward, facing right

consignes.death: is mortally wounded: her wings curl around her, she kneels with her head bowed, then folds slowly to one side, lying motionless on the ground at the end

demon.notes: Enfer, niveau 7 : le géant qui invoque des diablotins (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-15). Deux directions à essayer : décharné à tête de crâne, peau noire calcinée aux fissures de feu (L1 à L3) ; ailé et musclé, peau rouge sombre (L4 à L6). Il ne vole pas : ailes repliées ou à demi ouvertes. Nouvelle idée de l'utilisateur (2026-11-15, d'après une vieille référence) : un démon gras, surtout rouge, ailes, queue, sabots, barbe et crocs (L7 à L9). Choisi : L7-1 ; essai avec un trident (L10 et L11, idée de l'utilisateur). L10-1 choisi, fond blanc retiré (l10/1-avec-fond.png gardé), à sa taille d origine (132 px avec le trident : pas de réduction, plus net).
references: art-candidats/en-cours/candidats/demon/fixe/l7/1.png::the chosen demon: keep exactly this character, its fat red body, black beard, horns, orange wings, tail and hooves; only add the trident
demon.description: a huge fat demon standing on cloven black hooves, holding a long black iron trident upright in its right hand, the trident's three sharp prongs above its head: a big round heavy belly, thick arms, bright red skin with darker red shading, a broad face with a thick black beard, sharp white fangs, glowing yellow eyes, two short curved orange horns, big red bat wings half spread behind it with orange membranes, a long red tail with a pointed tip
demon.sujet: a huge fat red demon with a black beard, horns, red bat wings and a tail, holding a black trident, facing right

mouvements.hit: takes a blow and likes it: the head snaps back, then he looks up with a wide wicked grin, eyes wide with surprise and pleasure, the fat belly wobbles, the wings twitch, holding his trident, then recovers back to exactly its starting pose; stays on the same spot, nothing else in the picture

consignes.death: catches fire: flames engulf the huge demon, wings and trident included, it blackens and collapses inside the fire, then the fire goes out, leaving a small mound of pale grey ash on the ground, motionless at the end

diablotin.notes: Enfer, niveau 1 : le voleur de points de sort, il vole (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-15). Deux styles : peau rouge (L1 à L3), peau noire de suie aux yeux de braise (L4 à L6).
references: art-candidats/references/enfer/imp2.png::character reference (a skinny red imp with horns, a wide toothy grin, long clawed fingers and a thin tail): keep this design, its pose and its proportions

art-candidats/references/enfer/imp3.png::concept reference (a skinny hunched devil with horns, pointed ears, a wicked grin and long claws): keep the wicked grin and the hunched pose; ignore the ink style and the paper
diablotin.description: a small skinny imp crouching and grinning: a tiny hunched devil with a big head, pointed ears, two small curved horns, a wide wicked grin full of sharp teeth, big glowing orange eyes, long thin arms with long clawed fingers, thin legs with clawed feet, small bat wings on its back, a long thin tail with an arrow tip, sooty black skin with glowing orange eyes and orange embers in the cracks of its skin, mischievous and sneaky
diablotin.sujet: a small skinny sooty black imp with glowing orange eyes, small horns, a wicked grin, bat wings and a thin tail, facing right

mouvements.hit: flinches hard and is knocked back to the left, a big clear movement: its head snaps back sharply as if punched in the face, the whole small body is thrown backward to the left, arms and wings flailing, then recovers back to exactly its starting pose; stays on the same spot, nothing else in the picture

consignes.death: is killed: shrivels and curls up tightly into a small ball on the ground with its tail wrapped around it, lying motionless on the ground at the end

cultiste.notes: Enfer, niveau 2 : des humains qui ont vendu leur âme ; sacrifice avant chaque attaque (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-15). Deux styles : robe rouge à capuche (L1, L2), prêtre du sang chauve et tatoué (L3, L4).
references: art-candidats/references/enfer/occultist3.png::character reference (a cultist in a deep red hooded robe with gold trim, a grinning face with red eyes in the shadow of the hood): keep this design, the hood and the colours; ignore the copyright text and the background

art-candidats/references/enfer/occultist2.png::costume reference (a tall robed cultist with a red hood and a long dark red robe with gold bands): keep the long robe and the gold bands; ignore the grey background
cultiste.description: a human cultist standing hunched: a deep red hooded robe with gold trim and wide sleeves, the face in the shadow of the hood with glowing red eyes and a wicked grin, a curved ritual dagger in one hand, a rope belt, dark boots, sinister and fanatical
cultiste.sujet: a human cultist in a deep red hooded robe with gold trim, holding a curved ritual dagger, facing right

consignes.death: is mortally wounded: sways, the knees buckle and it crumples straight down into a heap of red robes, the hood falling over the face, lying motionless on the ground at the end; no blood, no fire, no flames

limon-magma.notes: Enfer, niveau 3 : l'essaim qui se divise (sans références ; deux styles proposés, 2026-11-15) : une masse de lave en fusion (L1, L2), un tas de roche noire et de lave avec une gueule (L3, L4).
limon-magma.description: a magma slime: a wide low blob of glowing orange molten lava with a dark cooling black crust cracked all over, bright yellow lava glowing through the cracks, thick drips of lava running down its sides and pooling at its base, two small glowing ember eyes, oozing and bubbling
limon-magma.sujet: a wide low blob of glowing orange molten lava with a cracked black crust and two ember eyes, facing right

mouvements.death: is destroyed: melts and collapses into a flat puddle of dark cooling lava on the ground; no effects, no other character
mouvements.hit: flinches away to the left: its soft body is squashed flat and sags backward to the left, then bulges back up, then recovers back to exactly its starting pose; stays on the same spot, nothing else in the picture

consignes.death: dies as its lava goes out completely: all orange and yellow glow fades away, it sinks and flattens into a low lump of dull black and dark grey cold rock, no glow and no orange left at the end, motionless, staying entirely inside the picture; no blood

tourmenteur.notes: Enfer, niveau 5 : le crochet ; un wendigo au crâne de cerf (références de l'utilisateur, 2026-11-15). Deux styles : os et cendre (L1, L2), rouge de l'Enfer (L3, L4).
references: art-candidats/references/enfer/tormentor1.png::character reference (a hunched wendigo with a deer skull, big antlers, a shaggy mane, a gaunt body, long clawed arms and hooves): keep this design, its pose and its proportions; ignore the ink style, the hanging crosses and the white paper

art-candidats/references/enfer/tormentor2.png::concept reference (a wendigo with a deer skull, antlers, visible ribs, black fur and very long claws): keep the visible ribs, the black fur and the long claws; ignore the ink style, the text and the white paper
tourmenteur.description: a tormentor demon, a tall gaunt hunched wendigo: a pale bone-white deer skull for a head with big branching antlers and sharp teeth, glowing red eyes in the sockets, a shaggy black mane on its neck and shoulders, sunken ashen grey skin with visible ribs, very long thin arms with long clawed fingers, digitigrade legs with black fur and hooves, a heavy rusty iron chain wrapped around one arm ending in a big sharp meat hook held in its claws, menacing
tourmenteur.sujet: a gaunt wendigo with a pale deer skull head and antlers, black fur, grey skin, long claws, holding a chain with a meat hook, facing right

mouvements.hit: flinches hard and is knocked back to the left, a big clear movement: its head and shoulders jerk backward and it leans back to the left, arms pulled in, then recovers back to exactly its starting pose; stays on the same spot, nothing else in the picture

consignes.death: is killed: its knees fold, it sits hunched, the skull slumps onto its chest and it slowly tips over sideways, lying motionless on the ground at the end
